svg.aria-label: Layer matrix: telephony, Bluetooth, GPS, NFC, fingerprint and sensors reach a HAL in the Android container over binder; display, audio, camera and face unlock load vendor libraries via libhybris; Wi-Fi, vibration, flashlight, brightness and battery use kernel devices directly.
svg.text: OVER BINDER TO A HAL IN THE ANDROID CONTAINER
KERNEL ONLY, NO ANDROID IN THE PATH
